content: libgit2's Remote::url() applies url.*.insteadOf rewrites at read time, so remote.url() can be a transport URL (e.g. a file:// stand-in) while config remote.origin.url keeps the raw pre-rewrite form. Canonicalize GitHub origins by trying rewrite candidates (fabro_github::rewrite_candidates) against BOTH views. Also: insteadOf replacements are URL prefixes (usually trailing-slash), so the rewritten path concatenates the unmatched suffix — test fixtures must place bare stand-ins at prefix+suffix, and a missing trailing slash silently produces a wrong path. Observed implementing fabro-f394 in fabro-manifest (fork_insteadof.rs).
